description: Use this when the user asks whom to tip at a wedding or how much to tip a vendor. Zola's general tipping guide for the caterer, hair and makeup, photographer, videographer, DJ or band, planner, drivers, officiant, florist, and delivery and setup teams, from Zola's tipping guide and Zola's 2026 Wedding Spend Survey. With a vendor type and its cost, it also gives the tip range in US dollars. Do not use for tips outside a wedding.

service_cost.description: What the vendor costs, in US dollars. Only with vendor_type, for a vendor with a percent tip.

vendor_type.description: Vendor type. Omit for all vendor types.
